# DEV Community

DEV Community (dev.to) is a community of software developers where you can publish articles, engage with others, and build your online presence.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/devto/.

## Actions

- **Get Current User** (read-only): Get the currently authenticated user's profile information.
- **Get Organization** (read-only): Returns a single organization by its username.
- **Get user** (read-only): Get a single user by their ID or username.
- **Create Article**: Create a new article on DEV Community.
- **Get Article By ID** (read-only): Returns a single published article by its ID, including full body content.
- **Get Article By Path** (read-only): Returns a single published article by username and slug path.
- **Get Comment by ID** (read-only): Returns a single comment and its descendants (replies) by comment ID.
- **Get Listing** (read-only): Returns a single classified listing by its ID.
- **Get Profile Image** (read-only): Returns the profile image URL for a user or organization by username.
- **List Articles** (read-only): Returns a list of published articles, optionally filtered by tags, username, state, or top articles.
- **List Comments** (read-only): List comments for a specified article or podcast episode on DEV Community.
- **List DEVTO Reading List** (read-only): Returns the articles in the authenticated user's reading list.
- **List Followed Tags** (read-only): Returns a list of tags followed by the authenticated user.
- **List Followers** (read-only): Retrieve a list of users who follow the authenticated user.
- **List latest DEV Community articles** (read-only): Retrieve a list of published articles sorted by descending publish date.
- **List Listings** (read-only): Returns a list of classified listings for jobs, mentors, products, etc.
- **List Listings By Category** (read-only): Returns a list of classified listings filtered by category.
- **List Organization Articles** (read-only): List articles published by a specific organization on DEV.to.
- **List organization users on DEV.to** (read-only): List users belonging to a specified organization on DEV.to.
- **List podcast episodes on DEV.to** (read-only): Retrieve a list of podcast episodes from DEV.to.
- **List Tags** (read-only): Returns a list of tags with their names, background colors, and text colors.
- **List User All Articles** (read-only): List all articles (both published and unpublished) for the authenticated user.
- **List User Articles** (read-only): List published articles for the authenticated user.
- **List user's published articles** (read-only): Returns a list of the authenticated user's published articles only.
- **List user's unpublished articles** (read-only): Returns a list of the authenticated user's unpublished (draft) articles.
- **List Videos** (read-only): Retrieve a list of articles that contain videos.
- **Update Article**: Update an existing article on DEV Community.
- **Update Listing**: Updates an existing classified listing on DEV Community.
